title: Integrative brain transcriptome analysis links complement component 4 and HSPA2 to the APOE ε2 protective effect in Alzheimer disease

evidence_spans.quote: We analyzed gene expression data derived from autopsied brains donated by 982 individuals

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This original report analyzes human brain gene-expression data and Alzheimer disease biology, but does not analyze or explicitly frame an aging process; Alzheimer disease alone does not establish aging-process relevance.
